boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 109 is a Super Hard blast board built around three blue `6` pillars and a row of hammer tools. The hammers break pillar tiles, and a yellow orb follows drawn red and yellow paths to finish the last clusters. The catch is sequencing: once the right hammer is spent, the center blast orb must fire — but triggering it before the left path clears strands half the board.
landmarks: Block Out Level 109 is a Super Hard blast board built around three blue `6` pillars and a row of hammer tools.
The hammers break pillar tiles, and a yellow orb follows drawn red and yellow paths to finish the last clusters.
The catch is sequencing: once the right hammer is spent, the center blast orb must fire — but triggering it before the left path clears strands half the board.

quickTips: The yellow blast orb is the finisher, not the opener.
Save the yellow hammer until the top-right `10` counter is visible.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Use the green hammer tile on the left blue `6` pillar to drop the top-left `13` counter.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Spend the purple hammer on the center `6` pillar once the left rail reads `10`.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the left `8` tile along the red guide path before touching the right pillar.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Save the yellow hammer until the top-right `10` counter is visible and the right rail still shows `7`.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Break the right blue `6` pillar, then move the yellow blast orb along the yellow guide path.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the bottom yellow tile under the starburst and close the remaining side-rail `9` count.

failurePoints: Triggering the yellow blast orb before the left `8` tile is gone.
Spending the yellow hammer too early, leaving the right pillar unbreakable.
